scientific_limitations: Real scalar positive-definite input (a positive multiple of the identity) only; raw independent Gaussian probes; exact arithmetic.
Only operator-monotone f with f(0)=0 and f(lambda)>0 is asserted; proof uses only these endpoint values.
The empirical diagnostic result concerns its expected square, not a samplewise error certificate or a tail bound.
Existing residual-normalization variants are deterministic for this flat-spectrum example, and the squared relative error of the raw method vanishes near rank saturation.
No independent scientific validation, external certification, or exhaustive novelty guarantee.
title: Exact covariance and diagnostic undercalibration for Gaussian exchangeable traces on flat spectra
